description.value:
Frequency at will

Make two Strikes, one with each weapon (or your weapon and your Snapjaw's jaws, if it's adjacent), against a single target, committing both into one overlapping attack and trading accuracy for the chance both connect. Both use your current multiple attack penalty, but against your Marked quarry the second Strike's penalty is reduced by 1 (2 at Veteran tier or higher) — the go-to opener.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live). This card's real blocker is independent: it's Waywarden's own Double Slice analog, and even real pf2e's system-native "make two Strikes as one attack, combine damage" resolution is hardcoded engine behavior, not something system.rules reproduces (confirmed via two spot checks: Fighter's Double Slice only rule-encodes its minor non-agile penalty; Fighter's Reactive Strike is granted via a bare GrantItem whose trigger is likewise hardcoded, not a generic hook). Any Waywarden card proposing an equivalent bespoke Strike-triggering or multi-Strike-resolving action inherits the same gap; the Mark-conditioned MAP discount on top of it (also undefined -- "Veteran tier" is unmapped, see waywarden.vanish-between-blinks.json's note) is moot until the base action shape exists.
